qs.q: A patient with osteoporosis and recurrent falls is managed with non-pharmacological interventions. Which multidisciplinary team should be involved to address unsteadiness?
o: Falls prevention team including occupational therapy
qs.e: Patients with recurrent falls or unsteadiness should be referred to a multidisciplinary falls prevention team such as occupational therapy. Other non-pharmacological measures include smoking cessation and adequate dietary calcium.
